title: pinus laricio var. poiretiana
intro: Pinus laricio var. poiretiana, commonly known as Stone Pine, is a subspecies of evergreen conifer tree native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Pinus laricio var. poiretiana include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of coughs, colds, and other respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
